set.body:
Scope: turn the reviewed equations into the executable v1 contract and freeze benchmark inputs before performance work.
Acceptance:
- Explicit PenalizedProfile versus full constrained-trial ML, fixed sigma/lambda and condition/run mean scope; document projected-determinant counterexample and lambda=0 exclusion.
- Specify units, chart bounds, normalization derivatives, rank policy and separate empirical/certified approximation and data/prior identification statuses.
- Freeze B0/sparse/dense/edge cohorts, seeds, noise/signal levels, exact reference host and conditioning-aware numerical tolerances; preserve the epic targets unchanged unless a recorded decision revises them.
- Retain independent Gaussian, discrete-state and continuous-Cascade34 probes with hashes and versions; do not treat the supplied unsupported numerical tables as fixtures.
Performance: publish baseline operation/memory accounting and an empty measurable results schema, not invented benchmark results.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-01: Freeze scientific estimands, admission domains and benchmark cohorts
